thread:
Tessa (PM): Quick sync  we need to pick scope for the next sprint: compact onprem packaging vs. upgrade handoff ergonomics. field customers pushed both.
Arun (Eng): What's the minimal deliverable that unblocks pilots?
Bea (Field Eng): For pilots: compact bundle that supports preloaded images, deterministic install order, and a one-page runbook. That would unblock ACME.
Noah (SRE): For upgrade ergonomics: automated pre-upgrade checks, pause/rollback API, and an observable event when egress mappings are changed. Those reduce on-call toil.
Rina (Customer Success): Two paying pilots: one needs airgap-friendly installs, the other wants low-risk upgrades during business hours. Both matter commercially.
Tessa (PM): Proposal: split sprint with clear launch gates. Track A (Packaging): tarball <1GB extra, offline helm apply pass, runbook + install-debug.log. Track B (Upgrade): preflight checks, pause hook, rollback template.
Arun (Eng): Estimated points: Track A 6 pts (2 spike + 3 work + 1 tests/docs), Track B 5 pts (3 work + 2 tests/docs). Two engineers can cover both if we split days.
Bea (Field Eng): I'll validate offline lab for Track A and draft the runbook. Also request the installer write /var/log/rw-install.log with phase/errors.
Noah (SRE): We'll need a simple revert flow for Track B that restores previous image tags and restarts pods in order. Also add an "upgrade-constraint-detected" telemetry event.
Tessa (PM): Risk notes: egress preservation depends on customer CNI; accept documented manual steps for some CNIs in v1. Also bundling increases artifact surface for support.
Arun (Eng): Dev plan: spike for compact packaging first 48h, then implement installer flags for preloaded images and --dry-run. I'll open RFC for operator pause API.
Rina (Customer Success): I'll negotiate pilot windows and confirm priority. If ACME demands faster delivery, we'll reallocate.
pkg-bot: CI queued: packaging/compact-bundle #5991 -> pending.
Tessa (PM): Action items: Arun spike PR EOW, Bea validate lab Thurs, Noah draft preflight checklist, Rina schedule pilot tests. Reconvene Friday 09:30 to lock scope.
